title: PLAYER 2 SEES A ROUND GLANCE OFF STEEL
why: A round that glances off a steel wall (v26 ricochet) turned only in the window that fired it. The tracer word went out once at the muzzle and the bounce sent nothing, so the other window drew the tracer stop dead at the wall: no bounce, no spark, no ping. Both directions. Proven in the cloud: a host round off a locked-room steel wall ricocheted and sent no word after the muzzle word; the partner window held no tracer leaving the wall. The bounce now sends its own word from the bounce point, and the other window draws the bounced tracer with the spark and the ping. It is not a new shot: no muzzle flash, no shot sound, no shot count. Old windows ignore the new word.
now: In co-op you see your teammate's rounds glance off steel, as he does.
